mapper.select: select * from tb_media_asset where id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update tb_media_asset set status = 'TEMP', expires_at = #{expiresAt}, delete_after = null, update_time = #{updateTime}, last_error = null where id = #{id} and status = 'UPLOADING'
update tb_media_asset set status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{lastError}, delete_after = #{deleteAfter}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 'UPLOADING'

update tb_media_asset set status = 'BOUND', bound_type = #{boundType}, bound_id = #{boundId}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, bound_at = #{boundAt}, expires_at = null, delete_after = null, update_time = #{boundAt} where id = #{id} and status = 'TEMP'
mapper.select: select m.* from tb_media_asset m join tb_orders o on o.id = m.bound_id and o.deleted = 0 and o.status = 0 where m.bound_type = 'ORDER' and m.purpose = 'ORDER_IMAGE' and m.status = 'BOUND' and m.visibility in ('PUBLIC', 'PRIVATE') and exists (select 1 from tb_order_address_snapshot p where p.order_id = o.id and p.role = 'PICKUP') and exists (select 1 from tb_order_address_snapshot r where r.order_id = o.id and r.role = 'RECEIVE') and m.bound_id in #{id} order by m.bound_id asc, m.sort_order asc, m.id asc
select id from tb_media_asset where (status = 'TEMP' and expires_at <= #{now}) or (status in ('UPLOADING', 'PENDING_DELETE', 'FAILED') and delete_after <= #{now}) order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update tb_media_asset set status = 'DELETED', delete_after = null, last_error = null, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING_DELETE'

update tb_media_asset set last_error = #{lastError}, delete_retry_count = delete_retry_count + 1, delete_after = #{deleteAfter}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING_DELETE'
